channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent, a router–worker super-agent prototype for always-on coding agents
item.description: DeepSeek has open-sourced a research prototype for always-on coding agents that manage their own work queues.

item.title: October at Agentic Finance Graph: 2.36M counted agent payments worth $9.09M, signed passes, Merkle-sum ledger
item.description: An independent ledger counted 2.36 million AI-agent payments worth $9.09 million in October, with signed verification of its figures.

item.title: An honest x402 seller earned $0.18 in two weeks and shut down; its host now offers free hosting for sellers like it
item.description: A small x402 seller earned just $0.18 in two weeks before shutting down, a reminder that agent payments are still early.

item.title: Context Labs launches AI Distillery: run AI on company data with cryptographic provenance, without surrendering the data
item.description: Context Labs launched AI Distillery, software that lets businesses use AI on their own data while tracing every answer back to its source.

item.title: OpenAI Evals goes read-only Oct 31 ahead of Nov 30 shutdown; Computer Use reaches general availability
item.description: OpenAI's Evals tool became read-only on October 31 and shuts down November 30, while its Computer Use feature is now generally available.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources Super-Agent, a proactive coding agent, alongside a reported ~$15B raise
item.description: DeepSeek open-sourced Super-Agent, a proactive coding agent that watches developer chats and suggests fixes, alongside a reported $15 billion funding round ahead of a planned IPO.

item.title: x402 passes ~196M cumulative payments settled, $42.3M in volume, as of Nov 1
item.description: A live tracker counts nearly 196 million x402 payments settled and $42.3 million in volume as of November 1, with Base the largest chain.

item.title: Zyrix launches ATLAS, an agent testing platform that issues an evidence-backed Go/No-Go before agents ship
item.description: Zyrix launched ATLAS, a testing platform that checks what AI agents actually do and gives teams an evidence-backed go or no-go before they ship.

item.title: Nov 1 builder roundup ranks Base44 top for a backend without configuring one
item.description: A November 1 roundup ranks Base44 top for non-coders wanting a full app backend without configuring one, with a free tier of 25 message credits a month.

item.title: Causa Prima raises $20M seed to put AI agents on both sides of every invoice
item.description: Causa Prima raised $20M to put AI agents on both sides of every invoice, targeting inter-company settlement for businesses.

item.title: Phinity Labs raises $5.2M seed to build AI agents that design chips from text prompts
item.description: Phinity Labs raised $5.2M to build AI agents that design computer chips from text prompts.

item.title: Instinct reportedly raising at a ~$30B valuation, per investor disclosures
item.description: Instinct is reportedly raising a new round at a valuation of about $30 billion, up from $10 billion in September — unconfirmed by the company.

item.title: State of MCP: October 2026 — 31 security advisories, 52,141 registry servers, spec unchanged until March 2027
item.description: A new State of MCP report counted 31 security advisories in October and over 52,000 servers in the official registry.

item.title: Shopify moves its AI agent knowledge base into Merchant Admin, retires standalone app Jan 15, 2027
item.description: Shopify moved its AI agent knowledge base into Merchant Admin, with the old standalone app retiring January 15, 2027.

item.title: Dataline raises $10.6M to give AI agents data they can trust
item.description: Dataline raised $10.6M to build a marketplace where AI agents pay per call for data, with free access for builders on Base and Robinhood Chain.

item.title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.42.0 adds agent context compaction controls
item.description: OpenAI's Python SDK 3.42.0 adds agent context compaction controls, session review, and experimental time awareness for agent builders.

item.title: Factory Droid 1.0: model-independent coding agent harness built on Script mode
item.description: Factory shipped Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness where the model writes a program to run its tools instead of calling them one by one.

item.title: Who actually pays on x402? An on-chain trace of Base sellers
item.description: An on-chain trace found 52 of 81 sampled x402 sellers earned nothing in 24 hours, with the best earning just $6-15 a day.

item.title: Instinct adds OpenTable booking, its 4th named integration in about 4 days
item.description: Instinct added OpenTable booking, its fourth named integration in about four days after Stripe Link, Shopify Shop Pay and 1Password.

item.title: AI Agent Framework Leaderboard updated Oct 31: Dify first of 43 open-source frameworks
item.description: Dify leads a new ranking of 43 open-source AI agent frameworks, ahead of n8n and Mastra, with 30 of the 43 shipping a release in the last month.

item.title: XRPL passes 14.5 million AI-agent x402 micro-payments, but only ~$33,500 settled
item.description: AI agents have now made over 14.5 million x402 micro-payments on the XRP Ledger, though total settlement is only about $33,500 so far.

item.title: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10B amid tech rout, FT reports
item.description: OpenAI reportedly cut its latest funding target by $10 billion to about $20 billion, with its valuation dropping to around $1.25 trillion, per the Financial Times.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-Rosalind-6 for approved biology researchers
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-Rosalind-6, a life-sciences AI model for approved research labs, priced at $15 per million input tokens.

item.title: CopperPilot raises $390,000 pre-seed for an AI design agent for electronics hardware
item.description: CopperPilot raised $390,000 to build an AI agent that turns plain-English descriptions into manufacturing-ready circuit-board designs.

item.title: Zest launches a personal AI restaurant concierge over text messages
item.description: Zest launched an AI restaurant concierge over text messages that recommends places and books through OpenTable, Resy or SevenRooms.

item.title: Phase opens AI agent blockchain mainnet with x402 payments
item.description: Phase opens AI agent blockchain mainnet with x402 payments

item.title: Visa, Mastercard and Amex join x402 Foundation to govern agent payment standard
item.description: Visa, Mastercard and Amex join x402 Foundation to govern agent payment standard

item.title: Easol raises $30M Series A extension to launch AI agents
item.description: Easol raises $30M Series A extension to launch AI agents

item.title: Zocdoc partners with Instinct for AI appointment booking
item.description: Zocdoc is partnering with Instinct so AI agents can find in-network doctors, check insurance, and book appointments directly into calendars.

item.title: DoorDash says it's only received 'several hundred' orders from AI agents
item.description: DoorDash says it has received only several hundred orders from AI agents so far, versus about 3 million deliveries a day.

item.title: Salesforce expands MuleSoft's Agent Fabric into an AI control layer
item.description: Salesforce expanded Agent Fabric with agent evaluations, a kill switch, and hard spending caps for agents running across platforms.

item.title: Obsero raises €1M seed to track the sources AI assistants quote
item.description: London startup Obsero raised €1M to track what AI assistants say about brands and which sources their answers cite.

item.title: Cohere announces initial close of Series E targeting up to C$7B at C$35.7B valuation, with Canada taking an equity stake
item.description: Cohere announced the initial close of a Series E round targeting up to C$7 billion at a C$35.7 billion valuation, led by Schwarz Group, with Canada taking an equity stake.

item.title: Deepgram acquires Daily, makers of open-source Pipecat voice-agent framework
item.description: Deepgram is acquiring Daily, the company behind the open-source Pipecat voice agent framework, and says Pipecat will stay free and open source.

item.title: Egnyte October release adds AI Control Center and MCP tool-access controls for agents
item.description: Egnyte's October release adds an AI Control Center to flag risky agents and protect sensitive content, plus tighter controls on which AI tools can access files.

item.title: AI agent security startup AIR raises $50M across two seed rounds, lands on Fortune Cyber 60
item.description: Tel Aviv agent-security startup AIR raised $50 million across two seed rounds and was named to Fortune's 2026-2027 Cyber 60 list.

item.title: Instinct reportedly developing an 'Agent Phone' giving its AI agent its own dedicated phone number
item.description: Reports say Instinct is developing an 'Agent Phone' feature that would give its AI agent its own dedicated phone number, though no launch date has been announced.

item.title: Hex raises $100M at $1.2B valuation and ships Hex 4.0, a rebuild for AI agents
item.description: Hex raised $100M at a $1.2B valuation and rebuilt its analytics platform from scratch so AI agents can read, write and tweak analyses as code.

item.title: Otter.ai raises $320M from General Catalyst's growth fund for its meeting tool
item.description: Otter.ai raised $320M from General Catalyst's growth fund to expand its meeting transcription tool, which turns meetings into actionable plans.

item.title: NVIDIA expands NemoClaw blueprints for specialized AI agents
item.description: NVIDIA expanded its NemoClaw blueprints, letting developers assemble governed AI agents from open models, harnesses and a secure runtime.

item.title: ZoomInfo launches MCP connector and API on Snowflake
item.description: ZoomInfo launched an MCP connector on Snowflake, letting AI agents query company and contact data inside Snowflake under existing permissions.

item.title: Airbyte launches MCP server to let agents talk with data pipelines
item.description: Airbyte launched an MCP server that lets AI assistants chat with data pipelines, diagnose broken syncs and fix issues.

item.title: Tencent plugs WorkBuddy into ERP, CRM and other enterprise systems via MCP
item.description: Tencent is plugging its WorkBuddy AI agent into ERP and CRM systems, with per-agent identity, action logs and human confirmation for risky steps.

item.title: Ares Intelligence raises €2.6M to turn employee insights into AI adoption plans
item.description: Ares Intelligence raised €2.6M to help companies plan AI adoption, using AI interviews with employees to map where agents can actually help.

item.title: Is x402 growing? Fresh on-chain accounting as of Oct 30, 2026
item.description: New on-chain data shows x402 agent payments are growing in count but shrinking in value, with the average payment now around three cents.

item.title: ServiceNow opens a 27-billion-parameter voice model
item.description: ServiceNow released Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open voice model that understands speech and replies with text or tool calls.

item.title: GitHub Copilot gets local AI models and sandboxed coding agents
item.description: GitHub Copilot can now run coding agents on a local model or in the cloud, with agentic sessions sandboxed for file and network safety.

item.title: Claris expands AI developer preview for FileMaker
item.description: Claris opened its FileMaker AI preview wider, letting coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor read and write FileMaker files directly.

item.title: Mintive raises $7M seed to police enterprise AI agents
item.description: Mintive raised $7M seed for identity and access controls for enterprise AI agents, including an MCP gateway that governs which services agents can reach.

item.title: XDC AI lets agents pay per call in USDC via x402
item.description: XDC AI lets AI agents pay per API call in USDC via x402, settling without a checkout page — demonstrated live with agents buying coffee and services at a build day.
